2026-06-17 — escrow recovery, running notes.

- 2024H2 is the envelope the retention audit is waiting on. The rest of the legacy tranche can go in the next
  window.
- Ravi wants every recovery written to /soc/CHANGELOG.md before the rails cutoff, not after. He has asked twice.
- The bulletin states each session whether a quantum decryption unit is provisioned to this desk. Provisioning
  has been intermittent — three windows since February, none longer than a day.
- /escrow/client-key-custody-2026 is the one item left in the legacy tranche that no other method opens; it needs
  the unit. It was attempted in the February and April windows and completed in neither, the first time because
  the window closed mid-pass and the second because it was queued behind 2024H2. It is still outstanding.
